faqs.question: Can it handle our specific commission structure, including tiers and accelerators?
faqs.answer: Yes. We sit down and map your actual rules first, whether that is flat percentages, tiered rates that jump at certain targets, accelerators above quota, split credit across reps, or clawbacks when an invoice is refunded. Because the engine is built around your policy rather than a fixed template, even unusual GCC-specific arrangements are handled exactly the way you pay today.

faqs.question: Does it connect to the CRM or accounting system we already use?
faqs.answer: It does. We connect the dashboard to your existing CRM, ERP, or accounting software so closed deals, invoices, and payment status flow in automatically. That keeps commission figures tied to real, paid revenue instead of numbers re-keyed by hand, and it means there is one source of truth for sales and finance.

faqs.question: Will sales reps and managers be able to use it in Arabic?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every dashboard, statement, and notification is delivered in both Arabic and English with full right-to-left layout support, so reps in the field and managers in the office each work in the language they prefer. Commission PDFs and WhatsApp statements come through bilingual as well.

faqs.question: Do we own the system, or are we locked into your platform?
faqs.answer: You own it completely, the source code, the data, and the documentation. There is no per-seat licence trapping you and no vendor lock-in. If you ever want to extend it in-house or move it elsewhere, everything is yours to take.

faqs.question: How do we know it fits before committing?
faqs.answer: Start with a free consultation where we walk through your commission process, then we prepare a demo preview tailored to your scenario before any commitment. The quickest way to begin is a WhatsApp message, and we take it from there.
